title: DonutTab+
body:
# Custom TAB Plugin Features (Paper 1.21.11)

### 1. Custom Rank System

* Create and manage custom ranks.
* Default ranks:

  * 🔴 Owner
  * 🔵 Developer
  * 🟡 Moderator
  * ⭐ Star
  * 🎥 Creator
  * ⚪ Member
* Customize rank names, colors, prefixes, suffixes, and symbols.

### 2. Rank Assignment Commands

* Give any rank to any player.
* Remove ranks from players.
* View player rank information.
* Create or delete custom ranks through commands.

### 3. Rank-Based TAB Sorting

* Players appear in TAB based on rank priority.
* Example:

  1. Owner
  2. Developer
  3. Moderator
  4. Star
  5. Creator
  6. Member
* Change priorities anytime through configuration.

### 4. Custom Prefixes & Designs

* Unique styled prefixes for every rank.
* Support for symbols, icons, gradients, and decorative designs.
* Example:

  * ⛔ OWNER
  * ⚙ DEV
  * 🛡 MOD
  * ⭐ STAR
  * 🎥 CREATOR

### 5. TAB Header & Footer

* Fully customizable header and footer.
* Display:

  * Server Name
  * Online Players
  * Player Rank
  * Ping
  * TPS
  * Welcome Messages
  * Website/IP

### 6. Ping Display System

* Show player ping in TAB.
* Color indicators:

  * 🟢 Excellent
  * 🟡 Good
  * 🟠 Average
  * 🔴 High Ping
* Customizable ping ranges.

### 7. Server Information Display

* Display live server statistics:

  * Online Players
  * Maximum Players
  * TPS
  * Server Name
  * Current World
  * Player Playtime

### 8. LuckPerms Integration

* Automatically sync ranks with LuckPerms groups.
* Detect prefixes and permissions.
* Optional manual override system.

### 9. PlaceholderAPI Support

* Support PlaceholderAPI placeholders.
* Examples:

  * %player_name%
  * %player_ping%
  * %server_online%
  * %luckperms_primary_group%

### 10. Animated Text Support

* Animated headers.
* Animated footers.
* Animated rank prefixes.
* Scrolling and flashing text effects.

### 11. RGB & Hex Color Support

* Full RGB colors.
* Hex color codes.
* Gradient text support.
* Modern Minecraft color formatting.

### 12. Sidebar Scoreboard

* Optional scoreboard system.
* Show:

  * Rank
  * Money
  * Kills
  * Deaths
  * Ping
  * TPS
  * Server Stats

### 13. Configuration Files

* Everything editable through:

  * config.yml
  * ranks.yml
  * tab.yml
  * messages.yml
* No hardcoded settings.

### 14. Permission System

* Admin permissions.
* Rank management permissions.
* Reload permissions.
* Custom permission nodes.

### 15. Multi-World Support

* Different TAB layouts for different worlds.
* World-specific headers and footers.
* World-specific rank displays.

### 16. Performance Optimization

* Lightweight and optimized.
* Supports large servers.
* Low memory usage.
* Fast TAB updates.

### 17. Custom Rank Priority Control

* Set exact order of ranks.
* Drag ranks higher or lower through config.
* Unlimited rank levels supported.

### 18. Easy Reload System

* Reload configurations without restarting the server.
* Apply changes instantly.

### 19. Multi-Language Support

* Custom messages.
* Different language files.
* Easy translation support.

### 20. Professional TAB Layout

* Clean and organized player list.
* Higher ranks always appear first.
* Attractive colors, icons, and formatting.
* Premium server appearance.

### Goal

Provide a fully customizable, professional, and modern TAB system where server owners have complete control over ranks, sorting, colors, animations, player information, and server statistics on Paper 1.21.11.
